title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python; strong data structures and algorithms foundation.
description: Gain hands-on experience building scalable applications, working alongside seasoned software engineers on high-impact cloud and enterprise tools.

title: Chevening UK Government Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree equivalent to an upper second-class 2:1 honours degree in the UK.
description: Chevening enables outstanding emerging leaders from all over the world to pursue one-year master’s degrees in any subject at any UK university.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open globally to self-motivated developers with 1+ years of experience with modern frontend frameworks.
qualification: Knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), React/Vue, HTML5, CSS3, and Git version control.
description: Work remotely on building robust web interfaces for GitLab's DevOps platform while collaborating asynchronously across timezone boundaries.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with up to 2 years of product/engineering experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering, or relevant technical field; strong analytical thinking.
description: Drive product vision, work with cross-functional engineering teams, and solve complex user problems across Google products.

title: Google Solution Challenge 2025
eligibility: Enrolled university students who are members of a Google Developer Student Club.
qualification: Ability to build a solution for one of the UN 17 Sustainable Development Goals using Google technologies.
description: Build a tech solution addressing local community issues tied to UN Sustainable Development Goals using Google products.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide with an internet connection.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML/CSS, and JavaScript.
